about_the_game:
Revel in the bliss of battle as you carve a path of destruction through the galaxy with the Champion of Khorne, Arthas Roqthar the Cold, and sate your thirst for carnage in the coming WAAAGH! with the ruthless Warboss, Grotmaz Smart. Each Commander comes with a unique voiceover.

This package includes:

  • Commander Arthas Roqthar the Cold with 10 skill points. He is trained for Hashidate and can be assigned to Japanese ships.

  • Commander Grotmaz Smart with 10 skill points. He is trained for Chengan and can be assigned to Pan-Asian ships.

You can have an unlimited number of identical Warhammer 40,000 Commanders simultaneously.

This time-limited exclusive DLC is only available between 21 May and 4 June, 2025.
